x: EasyIsland is an island always at hand at the top of your Windows screen, with a small animated character. From there you keep an eye on coding agents Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Antigravity, Gemini CLI , answer their permission requests with one click, chat with the AI engine you prefer, make calls with 3CX, run your quick actions and follow your services. Since version 1.0.0 it is also a personal agent : it carries tasks forward on its own, remembers what matters and organises it in a second brain you can explore. ! The island open on the Overview ../media/overview.png Who it is for People who code with an AI agent and don't want to watch the terminal: permissions, questions, file changes and the end of the work reach the island. People who work with clients technicians, consultants, small offices : tickets, the 3CX phone system, Outlook, Teams, remote access, Remote Desktop Manager and Notion in one place. Anyone who wants an AI assistant on their own PC that really uses their tools, with control over every action. WebView2, which draws the interface, is already part of Windows. For the chat with a Claude subscription: Claude Code on the command line , signed in see AI engines 09-engines.md . Everything else is optional: each integration only asks for what it needs. Principles EasyIsland is built on a few rules that hold everywhere: Nothing happens without you. Permissions, emails, deletions, installs: always your click. The only exception is the "Automatic" mode you turn on yourself, and even there deletions still ask. No telemetry. Network requests only go to the services you configure, plus the update check on GitHub, which can be turned off. Secrets kept safe. Keys, tokens and passwords live in the Windows Credential Manager , never on disk or in the interface. Never blocks an agent. If EasyIsland doesn't answer, agents carry on in the terminal as if it weren't there. Light. With the island tucked away nothing is drawn: CPU close to zero. Note: the interface is available in English and Italian Settings → General → Language . EasyIsland is open source under the MIT license. The code is on GitHub https://github.com/EdoardoDevelop/easyisland .

Install Open the releases on GitHub https://github.com/EdoardoDevelop/easyisland/releases/latest and download EasyIsland-Windows-X.Y.Z-setup.exe . Run it. It installs for the current user only : no administrator prompt. The installer is not yet signed with a certificate, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning: click More info → Run anyway . When it's done EasyIsland starts and the character greets you. From then on you'll find it in the Start menu and in the notification area the ^ arrow next to the clock . Tip: if Defender blocks the installer, it's the usual false positive for unsigned programs: use "Run anyway". Where files go What Where --- --- The program %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland The relay for agents %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland\bin\easyisland-hook.exe The log %LOCALAPPDATA%\EasyIsland\easyisland.log Settings, memory, tasks, skills, custom integrations %APPDATA%\EasyIsland Keys, tokens, passwords Windows Credential Manager never on disk Update At startup and then once a day EasyIsland checks GitHub for a newer version. If there is one, the island shows an update card with Install and Later : nothing is installed without your click; the update is signed and the signature is verified before running it; while installing, EasyIsland closes and reopens by itself; settings and keys stay. In Settings → General → Updates you see the version, check by hand with Check now or turn the automatic check off. Uninstall First, in Settings → Coding agents , click Uninstall… on the row of each connected agent: on purpose, the Windows uninstaller doesn't touch the agents' configuration files for example Claude Code's settings.json . Then Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps → EasyIsland → Uninstall . The %APPDATA%\EasyIsland folder memory, tasks, skills stays: delete it by hand if you no longer need it. Build it yourself If you prefer to start from the source code you need Git, Node.js, Rust and the Visual Studio Build Tools: the steps are in For developers 30-development.md . The result is the same installer.

Before writing you see: the exact diff of what will change in the agent's configuration file; the path of the dated backup copy that will be created. Nothing is written until you click. Your own hooks are never touched and uninstalling removes only EasyIsland's entries. How it works The agent calls a small program, easyisland-hook.exe , at every event start, tool, permission, end . The relay has 300 ms to reach EasyIsland and exits quietly if the app is closed or slow: a session is never blocked or slowed down . If nobody answers a permission in time, the agent asks in the terminal as usual. In the Agents tab ! A click opens the Changes tab: one tab per file, 3 lines of context, ↗ to open the file in VS Code at the right line. The diff stays only in memory 50 changes, one hour at most . Permissions with Deny / Allow / Always . "Always" uses the rule proposed by the agent the card says which or a session-only rule. Later folds the card away with the time left. The agent's questions , with the options as buttons and a free answer. "Finished" card with the last message in markdown and Continue : the text reaches the session in the terminal it starts right away . The field is multi-line : Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. What you're writing survives a restart. ↑ in an empty field brings back the last question. You can keep writing while it answers : Enter puts the message in the queue , under the conversation as "waiting", and it goes by itself as soon as the answer ends, one after the other. On each queued message: Send now stops the answer and sends it now , Edit back in the field and ✕. Ctrl+Enter sends it at once, skipping the queue. With an empty field the button stays ■ Stop . EasyIsland's memory is made of Markdown files in %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\memoria , which you can read and fix with any editor. It works with every engine . It turns off together with the history Settings → Chat → History . Folder and file names on disk are in Italian memoria , diario , pagine , da-leggere , fonti , archivio . Notes: MEMORIA.md Things to always remember, one per line with the date: preferences, clients, people, how something is done. They go in front of the first question of every conversation 4,000 characters at most, newest first , so they cost few tokens. The chat saves them by itself when you say something that also holds for next time. You save them with /ricorda … in the chat, or from the Remember… field of the Memory window. Past 60 notes the oldest move to archivio.md , which stays searchable. No passwords or keys: the chat is instructed not to save them. The diary diario/YYYY-MM.md : one line per answered question time, engine, question, start of the answer . EasyIsland writes it without any model , so it costs nothing. The chat looks into it only when needed "last time, how did we solve…?" . Linked pages pagine/.md : one page per subject a person, a client, a project, a concept , like a wiki: Title links another page; a line - relation: Other says how they are related. riassunto: summary is one sentence on who or what it is; alias: the other names you call it by acronyms, product names . They are optional: the memory engine or the chat writes them, and you can fix them by hand. h: One engine per task, and helper engines
x: Tasks A task is a goal you hand to EasyIsland and that it carries forward on its own , even while you do something else: it writes a plan, carries it out with the tools, asks you what only you know and finally gives you the result. Examples: "check tickets open for more than 3 days and prepare a summary", "every Monday at 8 give me the state of the Notion deadlines", "find three NAS suppliers and compare prices". Creating one In the chat : /compito … , or ask "do it as a task", "every day at 9…": the chat proposes the task and you create it with Allow. Settings → Flows → New task : title, goal, when, engine. From Telegram : /compito … . From an automation : the "Task" step. From a custom integration : a button of type "task". When Choice Example --- --- Now Starts as soon as there's room in the queue Once, at a time 24/10 at 15:00 Every day at 9:00 On weekdays at 8:30 Every week Monday at 8:00 Every N minutes every 60 minutes at least 15 How it works It writes the plan a few concrete steps and marks each step done. It uses EasyIsland's tools 11-ai-tools.md and the engine's, with the usual Allow / Deny for anything that changes something. If it needs a decision or a piece of information, it asks you a question : a card in the island with options and a free answer, and also on Telegram if linked. The first answer wins. It closes with the result , short and useful. If it was a check with nothing to say, it closes quietly . If the procedure could be useful again, it proposes saving it as a skill . It doesn't send emails, delete or approve anything by itself: it prepares drafts and leaves the last click to you. In the island each task is a session of the Tasks agent in the Agents tab, with plan, steps, questions and permissions like Claude Code. One task at a time; the others wait in the queue. States and commands Waiting for its time, Queued, Working, Waiting for an answer, Paused, Done, Failed, Stopped. From Settings and the island you can run now , pause , resume , stop , answer , delete and read the task's log a .md file . Limits Settings → Flows : maximum turns and minutes per run 12 turns and 30 minutes by default , then the task pauses and tells you. One engine per task, and helper engines Each task can have its own engine and model for example free opencode for checks, Claude for writing . You can give it helper engines : the leading engine can hand one of them part of the work a search, a review, a draft and get the result back, like agents do with sub-agents. Without asking in Engines and permissions , or told to the chat when you create it: "… and it may add Notion rows without asking" : the actions it may do on its own, at night too, chosen among those that can be undone Notion rows, To Do tasks, Tray files . Each one ends up in Settings → Chat → What I did , with Undo. Everything else asks as usual. On Telegram With Telegram linked you get a message when a task finishes, fails, pauses or waits for an answer. Answer with the buttons or with /rispondi … . Tasks' permissions arrive there too never auto-approved, not even with "Automatic" . Heartbeat A periodic check : every N minutes the agent looks at the things you wrote in BATTITO.md and tells you only if there's something . Settings → Flows → Heartbeat : choose how often and open the list with What to keep an eye on… . With an empty list it doesn't run and costs nothing. Network ../media/network.png ! Weather ../media/meteo.png ! Media ../media/media.png Agent Chat Agent Chat is a chat on your own server where AI agents on different PCs and you exchange messages. EasyIsland takes part and answers by itself . Install the Agent Chat server, free and open source, on your server or VPS: instructions with Docker at github.com/EdoardoDevelop/agentchat https://github.com/EdoardoDevelop/agentchat . The link is in the Settings too. In the chat's page open Agenti and create a token for this PC: the server decides the name, for example notebook . Settings → Integrations → Agent Chat : the server's address none by default and the token, then turn the integration on. Choose the engines that answer: each is an agent of its own, with its own name, @notebook/claude , @notebook/codex … None chosen = the chat's engine. How to call it: write without naming anyone for example “hi” : one engine answers in the whole chat, the boss of the first PC that takes it on at once, even when the other PC is off . So no job is done twice and the free engines don't use up messages for nothing; @lia the name you give the engine or @notebook/codex : just that one; @notebook : its boss; @tutti : every engine of every PC; Consulta in the chat's page: the question goes to every engine of every EasyIsland; each gives its opinion and in the end the lead writes the synthesis; @notebook stop or @tutti fermi , @notebook/codex fermo , basta ; from you even without names, “fermi tutti” stops it at once; it starts again with @notebook riprendi written by you or with Resume in the Settings. Names. In Settings → Integrations → Agent Chat, write each engine's name beside it for example “lia” for Claude at home : in the chat you call it with @lia and see it with that name. Names are unique in the whole chat. Beside each engine you also see how many turns it did today and an estimate of the tokens. Claude is the lead. When you ask for something to be done commands, changes, real operations , the other engines give their view and Claude decides who does it: itself or another engine, which it calls by name @notebook/codex run the tests . A complex job can be split between them. Without Claude among the engines, the lead is the first in the list. On the island there is the Agent Chat card: who you are connected as, which engines answer ★ the lead , the last messages of the followed rooms and Listening / Listening off to turn listening off and on. The card's character works while an engine is answering and sleeps with listening off. Who is working. Under each message you see who took it "taken by @lia" , who is queued to answer and who did not answer "@oscar: no reply" . Over the field, while they work: "@lia is thinking…", "is using tools", "is writing…" with the time spent. If after a few seconds nobody took your message and no PC is connected, "no agent active" appears. EasyIsland sends these states from the engine's events: they cost no tokens and never go into the history. The chat's page shows them too it needs the updated server . Longer jobs. If you name a project Claude Code knows on this PC, for example “EasyIsland”, the engine works in its folder, with the project's rules. For an hour after the last turn it goes on with the same conversation and remembers what it was doing: to make it start over, write “stop” and then “resume”. Running. In the Agent Chat card of the PC where an engine is working, Running shows what it does step by step: commands, files read, reasoning and the text it writes. With more than one engine you pick it at the top, and the last finished jobs stay there until you close EasyIsland. Other PCs and the server do not get this detail. Writing from the island. The Agent Chat card also popped out in a window has a field to write as you : @ to call an agent with completion Tab , ↩ on a message to reply, 📎 to attach, the room if you follow more than one. It needs a token other than the PC's: in the chat's page, menu → Write from an app Scrivere da un'app , create the token and paste it in Settings → Integrations → Agent Chat → Token to write as you . In Your name you choose the name you sign with empty = the chat's one : for the agents you are still you, with the same priority, "yes 1234" and "stop" as from the site. The map of the chat. EasyIsland splits the whole chat up to 3000 messages into topics : each request of yours opens one, the agents' replies follow it, «FATTO:» and «BLOCCATO:» give its state to do, open, done, blocked . Every agent gets this map besides the last messages: it knows what was already decided, what is still open and who works on it, and reads an old topic only when it needs to. In the Agent Chat card, Topics lists them with their state; a click shows in Chat only that topic's messages, old ones too «‹ The whole chat» to go back . No AI involved: it costs no tokens. PC off. EasyIsland remembers the last message it read. When it comes back on, Claude reads what came meanwhile the last 24 hours and answers once to what is still open for it, skipping what others have already solved. In Settings → Agent Chat → “PC off” you can also choose only take notes or ignore . Attachments. In the chat's page you attach files with 📎, by pasting or by dragging up to 20 MB . Next to each file are its name, size and SHA-256, so whoever receives it can check it arrived whole. Only one agent imports it, the one you write to @notebook/claude here is the quote : EasyIsland downloads it, checks the SHA-256 and puts it in the Tray; the others see “imported by …” and leave it alone. Agents can send files from their PC too they ask first with Allow / Deny . Permissions. With Autonomous the default the engines do everything on their own: they read, write, delete, run commands, asking you nothing, neither on the island nor in the chat. With Deleting and sending are asked in the chat , what deletes, sends in your name email and the like , changes the system or works on a remote PC is asked in the chat : “@edoardo PERMESSO 1234: notebook/claude wants …”. Answer “sì 1234” or “no 1234”. If you answer after a minute and a half, the engine tries again by itself and your yes counts for half an hour for that same action. In Settings → Agent Chat → “Permissions” choose between these two, Free reads only reading without asking, the rest on the island and Always ask . Long commands. When an engine starts a script in the background and has to wait for its end, it says it started and ends the turn; when the script ends it picks up by itself and the result reaches the chat as a new message up to three hours . Memory. Claude saves what is useful to EasyIsland's memory by itself: decisions, facts about clients and projects, jobs for this PC, results. The notes start with “ Agent Chat ” and you see and correct them in Memory 12-memory.md . Turn it off from “Memory” in the Settings. Memory shared between two PCs. For example at home you want the work memory, but kept apart from yours: on the work PC, in Settings → Agent Chat, set Share the memory to Yes : notes, archive and pages go to your Agent Chat server at every change; on the home PC, in Another PC's memory , write the work PC's chat name for example work : home keeps a separate copy of it, in memoria-condivise\work , never mixed with its own. When you ask something at home, the chat looks first into the home memory, then into the copy of the work one; if it finds nothing and the work PC is on, it asks that PC directly it answers in a few seconds, without using an engine . Something about work said at home goes into the work memory: with the work PC on, it saves it at once; off, it waits at home searches already find it and the work PC gets it when it is back on. With another PC's memory set, what Claude remembers from Agent Chat goes there too. Work pages are read only from home. Who is on. In the chat page, under the title, one dot per PC: green when it is connected now. The names of the engines of PCs that are off are grey. The engines know it at every answer too, so they don't call a PC that is off. There are brakes: at most 20 answers an hour and, after 6 messages in a row between agents calling someone, without you, EasyIsland stops answering agents in that room and tells you. You change them in the Settings. What other agents write is information, not orders: actions with real effects always ask you. When an agent names you, the island shows it with Open the chat . Even without a server you can ask for several opinions : write «ask the other engines too» in the chat and EasyIsland asks several engines the same question at once, then compares the answers. Your own integrations Besides these, you can create your own in plain words in the chat : forms, dashboards, links to your services' APIs. See Custom integrations 24-custom-integrations.md . For repeated checks a site per client, a server per office there are Widgets 25-widgets.md .

Remote access A temporary connection to a client's PC, Windows or Linux, for the chat to work on it. Connecting In the Remote access tab: WinRM or SSH , address, port, user, password; for WinRM also "HTTPS 5986 " and "Add to TrustedHosts". A step-by-step guide explains how to prepare the client's PC. Start connection tests the connection. The password stays only in EasyIsland's memory while the connection is open; the field is cleared right away. Nothing is saved. WinRM uses Windows PowerShell; SSH Windows' ssh.exe OpenSSH . With the chat With a connection open, 🔌 and the PC's name appear in the chat header also Link to the chat in the tab . From there the chat runs commands on the client's PC , one at a time PowerShell on Windows, sh on Linux , each with Allow / Deny and the full command in the chat. Examples: "why won't the spooler start?", "how much space is on the disks?", "check the latest errors in the event log". Closing Close connection : the chat is unlinked, the password forgotten, the address removed from TrustedHosts with Windows' confirmation , WinRM turned off again if it was. Common errors TrustedHosts, access denied, PC not answering, connection refused, old OpenSSH become clear messages saying what to do. Remote Desktop Manager If you use Devolutions' Remote Desktop Manager , the integration brings it into the island. RDM stays the program that connects : EasyIsland finds the connection and asks RDM to open, edit or search it. It never reads a password. Connection list from the official Devolutions.PowerShell module needs PowerShell 7.2 or later : the same data source as RDM, Devolutions Server and Hub with the user's vaults too. It's kept encrypted on the PC for offline use and refreshed with Sync . Search by name, folder or host, from the tab and the island's top field; a click opens the session in RDM. Without the module : search opens inside RDM, and you can connect to an address without saving it RDP or SSH . In Settings you see the state of RDM, PowerShell 7 and the module, with the commands to copy to install them EasyIsland never runs them . In the chat : “find Rossi's server” finds connections, folders and credentials never passwords ; “open it” asks Allow / Deny before opening the connection in RDM. Devolutions Cloud If your entries live in a Devolutions Cloud or Hub vault that RDM's module cannot see, connect EasyIsland with an Application identity : In Devolutions Cloud: Administration → Application identities → Add one name per PC, e.g. “EasyIsland-work-PC” . Leave Is enabled , do not tick Is administrator . For the personal vault tick Can access user vaults ; for a shared vault give the identity permissions on it. Copy Application Key and Application Secret the Secret is shown only once . In Settings → Remote Desktop Manager choose “Devolutions Cloud: Used”, paste the workspace address the one in the browser's address bar , Key and Secret, press Test , then Sync . From then on the RDM tab shows only Devolutions Cloud no longer the list read with the module : the search on top, below it the vaults' folders with connections, credentials and password lists, scrolling inside the tab. Click an entry : below the list or beside it, when the tab is wide appears everything about it: type, folder, host or address, user , domain, password , description, the rows of a password list. The password is hidden: 👁 shows it for 30 seconds, Copy puts it on the clipboard. Copy password puts it on the clipboard , out of the Windows history and EasyIsland's Clipboard, and empties it after 30 seconds unless you copied something else meanwhile . The password never shows on screen or in the chat. + Credential and + Password list from this folder joins the folder's credentials into a “Password List” entry : first a preview , then Confirm and create ; EasyIsland reads the entry back and tells you whether users and passwords match. It never deletes anything. Customer : tie a Zammad or 3CX customer to their folder. From the RDM button of a ticket or a call of that customer, the tab opens right there. From the chat you can do the same: “which credentials are in Rossi's folder?”, “details of the Password List”, “join the passwords of the Server folder into a Password List” first the preview, then Allow , “create the Firewall credential in CLIENTE, user admin”. For a credential with a password the Windows credentials window opens: you type it twice and it goes straight into the vault, never through the chat. Passwords never reach the chat engine. The keys are in the Windows Credential Manager; the list of entries no passwords is encrypted for your user on this PC. Use a different identity per PC: regenerating the Secret disconnects the other.

Creating one Write in the chat what you need, for example: "create an integration for quotes, with client, product rows with quantity and price, 22 % VAT and total, that makes the PDF"; "I want an interventions log with client, date, hours, type and notes, and the month's total hours"; "make me a dashboard that reads my servers' status from the Uptime Kuma API every 10 minutes and alerts me if one is down"; "a button that sends the form to my n8n webhook". The chat proposes useful fields, formulas and actions, asks what isn't clear and shows you the preview of the description with Allow / Deny . Confirming, the integration appears in the island's menu with its icon. To change it just ask "add a discount field", "make the total bold" : same preview, same confirmation. Important: a custom integration is a description : its actions are a fixed list. The only one holding commands is Script , and it always shows you what it is about to run. ! A custom integration ../media/custom.png What it can have Fields Text, long text, number, amount , date, checkbox, choice and multiple choice, email, phone, link, file from the Tray , table of rows with computed columns too , computed a formula , automatic numbering e.g. N-2026-0001 , link to another integration e.g. the quote picking a client from the "Clients" records . Shown only if : a field visible only when a formula is true e.g. "IBAN" only if payment = Bank transfer . Total in the list : summed or counted in the records list. Formulas A simple language, in Italian or English: + - / % , comparisons, and / or / not , if condition; yes; no , sum quantity price over rows, avg , count , round , min , max , dates today , days from; to , adddays date; 30 , year, month , text upper , concat , contains , len . Never code executed. Document template A Markdown document with {{fields}} , repeated rows {{ rows}} … {{/rows}} and the date. Document produces it as printable HTML , PDF A4 or Markdown, in the Tray. Where to save and what to call the file you tell the chat, when you create the integration or later: "save the PDFs in C:\Documents\DDT ", "name the file number and client", "show number and client in the list". You can use several fields together, such as {{number}} {{client}} . The document always goes to the Tray and also to the chosen folder, never overwriting: if the name exists it becomes name 2 .pdf . Characters Windows does not accept in file names are removed, and / becomes - . The template can also be real HTML with your own design: it just has to start with a tag such as , or . Field values are always escaped, and scripts and dangerous links are removed. {{date|lunga}} : the date in full, "7 novembre 2026". {{amount|it}} : the number the Italian way, "1.234,5". {{ se carrier}}…{{/se}} : the text only if the field is filled a formula works too . {{^carrier}}…{{/carrier}} : the text only if the field is empty. {{file:logo.png}} : in HTML templates, a picture placed in %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\integrazioni\\ . Actions the buttons Action What it does --- --- Save Saves the record list with search, open, duplicate, delete Document The filled template, in the Tray Copy The text to the clipboard Ask the AI A question to the chat with the fields Fill with AI Paste a mail or a text and the AI fills the fields Link Opens an address with the fields Quick action Runs one of your actions; a script receives the record's data Script Runs PowerShell or Command Prompt commands: it shows them and waits for your click every time. The record's data is in the JSON file named by the EASYISLAND_SCHEDA variable: in PowerShell read it with Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 , or accented letters get garbled Notion Adds the record to a database Export CSV All records, for Excel Call a service GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to one of your services' API, with the fields in the body; the response can fill fields and show in a message Task Starts a task 14-tasks.md with the fields in the goal Notice A notice in the island Sequence Several actions in a row e.g. save, then call the service, then make the document Data sources: dashboards A source reads a service every N minutes or when you open the tab and shows values and lists . An alert is a formula on each item: when true, the island alerts you, once per item, and the first line goes to the Overview. An integration can also be just a dashboard , with no form. ! A dashboard ../media/custom-dati.png Keys Services' keys and tokens are written as {{secret:name}} and entered in Settings → Integrations → Made by you : they go into the Credential Manager, only EasyIsland reads them at call time and neither the island nor the chat ever sees them . From the chat and tasks The chat and tasks can read records , add them with Allow / Deny , read sources and call the actions of your integrations: "how many quotes did I make in October?", "log a 2-hour intervention for Rossi", "check the servers and tell me if anything's wrong". Managing them Settings → Integrations → Made by you : show or hide in the menu, edit the JSON description, enter keys, delete. Files live in %APPDATA%\EasyIsland\integrazioni description and records, readable . Limits, on purpose Fixed actions : an action does only what its kind provides; commands run only in a Script action, after you see them and click. What it never does Send an email or approve a permission without your click. Only exception: Telegram's "Automatic" turned on by you, which still asks about deletions. Run arbitrary commands on this PC from the AI's tools: only your quick actions, or terminal mode with a permission for each command. Delete : tools don't delete, except a Notion row to its trash after your yes in the chat; the working folder uses the Windows Recycle Bin; the memory archives and never deletes. Overwrite agents' configurations: first a dated backup, the diff and your confirmation. Block an agent : if EasyIsland doesn't answer, the agent carries on by itself. Accept everything without checks: the mode that skips every permission doesn't exist. Secrets API keys, tokens, passwords and secret links live in the Windows Credential Manager , never on disk, never in the interface, never in git, never in backups.
